defect_found_by_this_work.description: exchange() accepted a caller-supplied adapter but never declared its ctypes ABI, so necko_tls_alpn returned an int and .decode() failed
defect_found_by_this_work.fix: declare_adapter() is now reusable and is applied to caller-supplied libraries; a regression test asserts the call sites exist
defect_found_by_this_work.why_it_was_invisible: every earlier probe went through load_adapter(), which declares the ABI; passing a library in directly is the only path that exposed it
